verdict.rationale: First-party docs show domains can be added and verified via the dashboard, the API (a dedicated verify-domain endpoint), the CLI, or the MCP server. The llms.txt explicitly ties domain verification to SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and per-domain DKIM keys are generated. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the exact generated DNS record values returned by the API, an explicit verification-status field or polling via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
